name: Dumbbell Reverse Spider Curl
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with your arms hanging and palms facing back.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders while keeping the backs of your hands uppermost.
Extend your elbows to lower the dumbbells to the start.
tips: Keep your upper arms vertical as your forearms rise.
Keep your wrists straight and your chest resting against the pad throughout.
